userManual.title: Geography Master — How It Works
userManual.intro: Geography Type Master and Geography Unit Master work together to define your ULB's location hierarchy, used across water-bill connections and billing.

steps.step1: Geography Type Master defines the levels of your hierarchy (Zone, Ward, Locality) along with their order (Level No).
steps.step2: Geography Unit Master defines the actual units (e.g. "Zone 1", "Ward 1") and assigns each one a Geography Type.
steps.step3: Each unit can optionally have a Parent Unit from a higher level — for example, "Ward 1" can be linked under "Zone 1", and "Locality 1" under "Ward 1" — building the full hierarchy.

userManual.note: Always create Geography Types first, then add Geography Units that reference them — units cannot be created for a type that doesn't exist yet.
